# The Barn at Graver's Tree Farm (concept by Kerblabs, not affiliated)

> Barn wedding venue in Tamaqua, Pennsylvania: an 1850s barn with original stone walls and rough-cut timbers (per graverestate.com).

## Venue (as listed on their site)
- Three ceremony sites: Apple Orchard Courtyard, Fern Creek, Waterfall Garden
- Two-floor barn interior with upper and lower event spaces
- Bridal Suite and Groom's Lounge
- Grounds: spring-fed pond, fountains, brooks
- Pricing: not published, contact them

## Contact
- Address: 841 Dairy Road, Tamaqua, PA 18252
- Phone: (570) 386-8932
- Email: graverestate@gmail.com
- Site: https://graverestate.com (Wedding Request form, Book A Tour)
